policy: Append incidents and incident updates. Never remove historical entries; mark resolved incidents with resolved_at and a final resolved update.

updates.body: We are investigating an outage affecting services hosted on the POWER environment. The independent status page remains available. Initial detection time is approximate.
The team identified a host crash followed by Docker Desktop's WSL2 backend failing to mount its virtual disk because access was denied. Recovery work is in progress. This incident is not resolved.
